title: oryzopsis thomasii
intro: Oryzopsis thomasii, commonly known as Blue Wildrye, is a perennial grass native to North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and relieving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Oryzopsis thomasii include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating conditions such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
